en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2234 - It is narrated from Ishaq ibn Ammar, who said:

"I said to Abu Abdullah (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq), peace be upon him: 'A man consulted me about performing Hajj, and he was in a weak financial state, so I advised him not to perform Hajj.'
The Imam (as) replied: 'How fitting it would be for you to fall ill for a year.'
Ishaq said: 'And so I did fall ill for a year.'"
